title: Measuring with non-standard units
examples: Can we measure the table with your hands?
Are cubes always the same size?
What if we use different sized blocks?

explain.say: Today we learn to measure things with blocks.
We can use small cubes to see how long something is.
Look at this box. We can line up the cubes to see how many fit.
You can also use your own hand span to measure things out.
It is important that all our measuring units are the same size.

items: All units must be the same size.
Consistency is key to accurate measurement.

faq.q: Why must the units be the same size?
faq.a: If your units are different sizes, your measurement will be wrong. We need everything to be equal to count correctly.
asks: Do the units have to match?
Why can't I use big and small things?

faq.q: Can I use my hands to measure everything?
faq.a: You can use handspans for some things, but cubes are better for straight lines. Different tools are good for different jobs.
asks: What is the best thing to measure with?

faq.q: How do I know how many cubes long something is?
faq.a: You line the cubes up end to end until you reach the end of the object. Then you count them all.
asks: How do I count the blocks?

faq.q: Is my handspan always the same size?
faq.a: Your handspan is usually quite consistent, but it is better to use a real ruler or standard unit. Practice helps make it steady.
asks: Is my hand always the same?
Can I use my hand for measuring?

faq.a: A non-standard unit is anything we use to measure that is not a proper ruler. Cubes and handspans are examples.
asks: Give me an example of a non-standard unit.

facts: Cubes can be used to measure the length of objects.
A handspan is the width from the tip of your thumb to your pinky finger.
For measuring to be accurate, all units must be the same size.
We can use cubes or handspans to estimate length.

quiz.say: If a pencil is exactly 5 cubes long, how many cubes long is it?
quiz.why: You lined up five cubes perfectly along the pencil's length.

wrong.1: This is too few cubes to cover the whole length.
wrong.2: This is too many cubes; it would be much longer.
wrong.3: You must use the same unit, so cubes are better here.

quiz.say: If you measure a book with your handspan, and it takes 4 handspans, what is the measurement?
quiz.why: You used your handspan consistently four times to measure the book.

wrong.0: You multiplied instead of just counting the units.
wrong.2: You were asked to use your handspan, not cubes.
wrong.3: You must name the unit you used, which is handspans.

quiz.say: A table is measured using cubes. If the measurement is 8 cubes, what does this mean?

options.show: The table is 8 cube lengths long.
options.say: The table is 8 cube lengths long.

quiz.why: It means eight cubes fit exactly in a line across the table.

wrong.1: You must specify what kind of unit you used.
wrong.2: The problem specified that cubes were used for this measurement.
